revision.note: production is the published site at the revision it served; live is a server of the evidence branch (bb844110bd, the head #1123 landed, with this branch's script changes in its working tree)

G0.name: repository audit
G0.command: majordomus capabilities; scripts/ui pages; git rev-parse HEAD
G0.result: routes, capabilities and revisions above; the source/capability map is ADR 0158 and docs/MAJORDOMUS_UI.md#the-observatory
G0.unknowns: no physical wall display was available; every browser figure is headless Chromium

G1.name: data proof
G1.result: a claim appended to a real runtime's journal arrives above the cursor of observatory.events with one identity however often it is read; an expired cursor is reported

G2.name: pixels proof
G2.result: the newest event of the live journal is the newest event of the display's own model, by identity (PASS)
G2.caveat: the binding from the model to a painted stroke is the renderer's code; no check reads pixels per event

G3.name: continuity proof
G3.result: scenes rotate fairly in declared order with each scene's dwell and skip unavailable and quarantined scenes; new journal events interrupt for the river after the minimum dwell (PASS, reason 'interrupt: 3 new event(s)'), not again within the cooldown (PASS), and a reader's choice holds 300 s and is never interrupted

G4.name: recovery proof
G4.result: drills in the browser: a throwing renderer is quarantined and the rotation goes on (PASS); a lost server reads STALE and LIVE again (PASS); an expired cursor reads RESYNCED (PASS); the river holds at most 200 events and remembers at most 4000 identities
G4.caveat: the display paints a 2D canvas, so there is no GPU context to lose

G5.name: privacy proof
G5.command: cargo test --lib -- capability::builtin::observatory; case 3011; grep -E '[0-9a-f]{16,}' over the recording and this evidence
G5.result: the recording names machines, runtimes, sessions and events by ordinal and keeps no body; the projection carries no event body and no link into another surface; the published replay is labelled REPLAY with its time; the evidence here records events by kind and clock only

G6.name: UX and performance proof

accessibility.rules: axe wcag2a wcag2aa wcag21a wcag21aa wcag22aa

soak.heap_note: Chromium rounds performance.memory without --enable-precise-memory-info: the hour's heap readings are buckets

G6.caveat: frame rates are headless Chromium's display loop on the machine named, not a panel's; no physical 4K display was measured

G7.name: deployment proof
G7.result: #1110, #1117, #1119 and #1123 merged pinned --admin after local gates; production serves 6f28de920723 (version 0.25.0); /ui/observatory/, /ui/kiosk/, /ui/screensaver/ and /features/observatory/ answer 200
G7.caveat: the release tag v0.25.0 is cut by the release seat when a master commit's ci is green
